messages:
Priya Kapoor: Heads up — prepping EBR dry run for AtlasPay next Wed 3:00pm PT. Need slide lane owners (onboarding, renewal risks, demo choreography, customer feedback), exec talking points, and any outstanding enablement asks. Ping if you can own a slide or cover a gap.
Alex Chen: I can own the onboarding health slide. Will pull the latest onboarding pulse and highlight blockers.
Samir Patel: I’ll take renewal risks + playbook. Need current ARR & commit cadence. @Brandon Torres can you confirm the numbers?
Brandon Torres: Confirmed — ARR + upsell pipeline in the drive: https://drive.redwood/AtlasPay/EBR/ARR_2026.xlsx :thumbsup: Also added a short note on churn drivers.
Marta Rivera: I’ll do demo choreography + slide for live flows. Can someone share the latest staging snapshot we plan to demo?
Jenna Liu: I’ll collect customer feedback bullets and the NPS highlights. @Priya Kapoor can you drop last week’s call notes here? I have two customer quotes to include.
Priya Kapoor: Pasted call notes below — pulled the key asks and exec quotes. Please pull whatever you need: ```
- Customer: "99th p latency is our primary risk to adoption"
- Ask: tighter SLO guarantees on peak days
- Success metric: 50% fewer manual reruns of inference jobs by EBR
```
CS-Bot: Reminder: EBR dry run scheduled Wed 2026-03-25 15:00 PT — calendar invites sent to execs and cross-functional leads.
Alex Chen: Quick question — are we keeping the fallback / graceful degradation slide? I vote yes, it helps execs understand reliability posture.
Samir Patel: +1 keep fallback. Add a one-liner: "Fallback to quantized 2.7 model in region X reduces latency spike risk". Also will add renewal risk buckets (exec engagement, usage signal, SLO gaps).
Priya Kapoor: Slide owner list so far: Alex = onboarding health, Samir = renewal risks, Marta = demo choreography, Jenna = customer feedback + NPS. Brandon — can you attach the ARR snapshot to the renewal slide in the drive?
Brandon Torres: Done. I uploaded the table and a brief comment on committed vs. expected renewals. Link above now has sheet named "EBR_commit_snapshot".
Jenna Liu: Adding two customer quotes + NPS trend chart. Will highlight a recent enhancement request (streaming responses) as an ask.
Marta Rivera: For demo — planning a short 4-min walkthrough + 3-min failover demo. Need someone to run the failover script during dry run. Any volunteers?
Alex Chen: I can run the failover script in staging. Can someone paste the command?
Priya Kapoor: Failover runbook snippet (staging): ```bash
./scripts/failover.sh --env=staging --model=quant-2.7 --timeout=300
```
Samir Patel: Action items recap (drop by EOD tomorrow please): - Alex: onboarding slide + 1-line status - Samir: renewal slide + risk buckets - Marta: demo plan + who runs failover - Jenna: feedback slide + 2 quotes - Brandon: attach ARR sheet & numbers - Priya: executive talking points + opening 1-liner
Brandon Torres: Acked. I’ll also add a 1-line note on churn mitigation activity.
Priya Kapoor: Thanks all — if anyone hits blockers, flag here. We’ll do a pre-dry-run sync 30m before the session. :rocket:
